review.recipe: Chilled tulip copita corrected from wineglass; transparent nearly colourless still tequila/blanc/peach cocktail, no ice or garnish.
review.personality: Repaired walking pouch and rubbed binoculars convey returning to observe without taking. Portrait keeps both legible; reused paper pouch is secondary.
review.world: Historic dark timber and contact-worn walnut, one practical warm lamp with neutral shadows, handled cream blank tag, no magical reflection.
